text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Visiting the academy like this really 
brings back memories of my own time 
here...

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Ryoka-san, was your 
school uniform a sailor suit back then?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Both my middle and high school uniforms 
were blazers. I've never worn a sailor 
uniform like the ones here at Tracen 
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! ...I'm kinda curious what Suzuka-san 
was like back when she was a student...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, oh please. I was just an ordinary 
student you could find anywhere, really.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
No! I mean you, Ryoka-san. I'm sure you 
were sparkling and wonderful back in your 
student days too!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...Wanna check, then? My graduation album 
is back home.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Are you serious?! I wanna see! So 
badly!!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
On one condition, though. In exchange for 
showing you mine, you have to show me your 
album too, Elfi.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Even I'm curious... about the sparkle from 
your student days.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Then on our next day off, 
let's have a drinks party and look at our 
graduation album!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, please tell me lots and lots 
of your memories!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please tell me lots of memories about 
Elfi too, okay?
